  - Link: https://uzairkhatri.com/work/wellows/
- **Savyour (Fintech & Distributed Backend)**: Architected distributed mutex locking with Redis Redlock, idempotent HMAC webhook ingestion, Bloom deduplication, and PostgreSQL double-entry transaction ledger.
  - Link: https://uzairkhatri.com/work/savyour/
- **ClassFlow (Marketplace SaaS & Concurrency)**: Architected timezone matchmaking state machine, Redis Redlock booking slot holds to prevent concurrent collisions, and Stripe Connect ledger reconciliation.
  - Link: https://uzairkhatri.com/work/classflow/
- **Enterprise Insurer (Enterprise Workflow & Integrations)**: Architected automated OCR capture, centralized content indexing, rules-based underwriting dispatch, and Active Directory / LDAP governance across branch workflows.
  - Link: https://uzairkhatri.com/work/efu-life/
- **Production RAG (Reference Implementation)**: Public FastAPI reference demonstrating hybrid BM25 + dense retrieval, reranking, grounded citations, Recall@5 and MRR evaluation, and CI regression gates.
  - Link: https://uzairkhatri.com/work/production-rag/
